# Prayagi Store & Services (प्रयागी जन सेवा केंद्र)

> Local application, travel and insurance assistance in Naini, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Services
- PAN card application: help with online application forms and document preparation.
- Passport application assistance: help with forms and preparation, not a passport-issuing office.
- IRCTC train ticket booking through CSC, subject to availability and booking rules.
- Car and bike insurance information and assistance through Turtlemint POSP, subject to insurer terms.
- Other services and document guidance are on the homepage.

## Visit and contact
- Shop No 2, Vinod Mehra Market, Sangam Road, Near Arail Prathmik Vidyalaya, Naini, Prayagraj 211008.
- Monday-Saturday: 09:30-14:00 and 16:30-20:00. Sunday closed.
- Phone: 0532-2972822. Email: prayagijanseva@gmail.com.
- [Home](https://prayagi-store-and-services.github.io/): services, document guidance, request form, hours and contact.

Approval, processing time, confirmed train seats and insurance claims are not guaranteed. Confirm current charges and requirements with the shop.
